crossRefs.note: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, and Gezer with…
They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this…

parallels.note: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
translations.bsb: So David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
translations.kjv: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
translations.asv: And David did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
